text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yikes,
this place is the real deal! I'm way
out of
my element!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To explain why we're here, we have to
go back a little bit. It all began when
Nishino Flower
approached Tosen
Jordan for advice...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So, I put a photo of my nails on Umatter,
and
someone commented suggesting I
make a
nail-themed packed lunch.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I thought that sounded fun... but I can't
come up with a good idea. I want to
make something
stylish—what do you
think?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You want it to look glam for the
photos,
yeah? How about these? I keep
seeing them on
my feed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Japanese sweets! They'd look super
cute in
the lunchbox!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... I've never made anything so
highbrow
before...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Who said anything about
eyebrows?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, if it's about sweets, I know just
who to
ask.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Japanese sweets? Then I'd recommend a

workshop for beginners. The experts will
guide
you through all the steps.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm rather interested myself, actually.
Would it be
all right if I tagged along
when you go?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, totes. Can you handle the
reservation, then?
You know way more
about this stuff and all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They also figured having a chaperone
would be
preferable, which is the exact
moment I happened
to pass by...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I can sense a solemn adherence to
tradition and
ceremony. I think we'll
have a great experience
making sweets.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I could be more out of
place...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-it's okay,
we're in this together! Um... I think we
get to try some tea and sweets
before the
workshop begins.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
A private room?! We're not gonna have
to be all
prim and proper, are we?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I read a book on Japanese culture once
that said
Japanese sweets go hand in
hand with formal tea
ceremonies.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Pardon my intrusion. We will now be
preparing
your tea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A number of kimono-clad staff enter the
room. They place trays of traditional
sweets before us
and begin preparing
the tea.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text: Please, help yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? We're already eating?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I think it's proper etiquette to
finish
the
sweets before the tea.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I read that as well. It was quite
surprising.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You know your stuff, huh, Flower? Help
a girl out
here—I'm in way over my head!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'd like your guidance too, if you don't
mind. I've
studied tea ceremony, but I'm
far from an expert.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course! B-but it's not like I have
any formal
practice, so... I'm sorry if I get
anything mixed up!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Man, you're so put together, Flower.
Mad
respect, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I admire how open-minded you all
are.
Many people would find it difficult
to ask
someone younger for help.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I admire how open-minded you all
are.
Many people would find it difficult
to ask
someone younger for help.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was that a low-key compliment?

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Do pardon me for speaking out of turn.
Please make yourselves at home. It
wouldn't be a worthy experience if you
couldn't relax and enjoy
yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, so, like, are selfies cool?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Psst, Jordan! That has to be against
the—

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Yes, take as many photos as
you'd like. Nothing makes us happier
than others
appreciating Japanese
sweets and tea.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
M-me too! I want to take pictures of the
sweets!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That workshop was a very enriching
experience. It
certainly helped broaden
my perspective on
Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For sure. It was cool trying something
you
normally don't get to do.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Now I can use my knowledge about
making
Japanese sweets to make cute
decorations for my
packed lunches!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you need any tips with your nails, let
me know,
yeah? I got you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The trio chatter excitedly on the way
back, sharing ideas for Nishino Flower's
Umatter
photos. There's no doubt they'll
turn out great.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All is silent but for the sound of a
bamboo tea whisk. I sneak a sideways
glance and see Tosen
Jordan and Eishin
Flash looking pained.

text_block_list.name: Jordan & Flash
text_block_list.text: Hnnnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow,
ow! Sitting in seiza sucks! I can't
feel my
legs!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, I'd hazard a guess that it's
impolite to be
stretching like that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: C'mon, it's just us here.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Besides, I know you're totes numb too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh! P-please don't poke me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, try leaving some space between
your legs
and crossing your big toes. It
helps to avoid going
numb.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, no kidding. That's way better! ♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So this is how you're supposed to sit. As
someone
without much experience, your
advice is a
lifesaver. Thank you, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, happy to help. But if it starts to
hurt, you
can always just say "excuse me"
and sit normally.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so glad we've got you here.
Like, marry
me, girl!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: C-come on, you'll make me blush!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Flower, if you notice anything wrong
with my
etiquette, please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't think you have to worry
about that.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The staff have already left, so that's
probably
their way of saying we can
make ourselves at
home.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What if they're just cutting us some slack
after
seeing our horrible posture?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Gasp! That would be... a little embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Meh, I say we thank them. Time to kick
back and
relax.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Let's enjoy the tea and the
sweets at our
own pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After we take our time savoring the tea
and sweets, we take part in the
sweets-making workshop. From
beginning to end, everyone is all
smiles.
